title: Cleveland walk-offs pile up: four in one day, three within minutes on September 4
dek: On September 4, 2026, the Cleveland Guardians organization recorded four walk-off victories across its major league and minor league affiliates in approximately three hours. Three of the wins came within minutes of each other, all by left-handed batters in second games of doubleheaders.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Four walk-off wins in one day across the Cleveland Guardians organization, with three occurring within minutes of each other.
bottom_line: The clustering of walk-off finishes across the system in a single afternoon offers material to study about clutch performance timing and organizational culture; the question is whether September 4 reflects something durable about this Guardians roster's ability to finish close games down the stretch.
body:
The Cleveland Guardians organization recorded four walk-off wins on September 4, 2026, across its major league and minor league affiliates, with three of the victories coming within minutes of each other in the second game of doubleheaders. All three of those walk-offs were hit by left-handed batters. The span covered approximately three hours.
In the major league game, Brayan Rocchio hit a game-winning homer to lead off the bottom of the ninth inning in the first game against the Tigers. Rocchio had previously tied that game with a grand slam. Travis Bazzana then walked off the Tigers with a single in the bottom of the tenth inning in the second game, having earlier tied his game with a two-run blast.
In the minor leagues, Juan Benjamin of High-A Lake County hit a walk-off two-run double to beat Great Lakes in the second game of a doubleheader. Nolan Schubart, Cleveland's No. 24 prospect at Double-A Akron, hit a walk-off two-run double to down Richmond in the second game of his team's doubleheader.
All four walk-offs occurred in nightcap games.
